  "pros": [
    "Keeps all project communication and files organized in one central place.",
    "Straightforward interface makes it easy to manage tasks and client collaborations.",
    "Predictable flat-rate pricing is highly beneficial for self-employed consultants."
  ],
  "cons": [
    "Lacks advanced project management features like task dependencies or detailed reporting.",
    "Can feel overwhelming when managing multiple active projects simultaneously.",
    "Limited customization options for workflows might require workarounds."
  ],
  "overall_experience": "As a self-employed consultant, Basecamp provided a solid and intuitive platform for managing e-learning projects and collaborating with clients. Its ability to centralize communication and documents was a significant advantage, reducing tool fatigue. While some advanced features were missing, its ease of use and transparent pricing made it a valuable tool for staying organized."
